en.s.04cebd9fd28f3ce5.text: The driver arrives in seven minutes but I leave in five.

en.s.0bf2dd341c42f6ad.text: Could you confirm whether my checked bag made it onto the connecting flight?

en.s.1b875bf82f728aa6.text: Do you have a cable you can lend me?

en.s.314f94b7b6857bcd.text: It's late, I have to go.

en.s.69c79b1bc9da0cc8.text: Is there a pool in the hotel?

en.s.8a5a4f8bbe394339.text: You should take care of your health.
